$Comment: The temple hub's way back to the Forgotten Temple: the game's own temple gateway pad (its Parent, Forgotten_Temple_Portal_Enter: the same pad, glow and sound), standing in the marble niche on the Concourse. Stepping on it, or pressing F on it, runs ZigOpen on the Instance destination of the game's shared temple copy, the same way back the Porter offers: a player who came in by the Doorkeeper lands beside it again and keeps the temple's own exit to the gateway they came by; anyone else arrives at the temple's landing. Its map marker is the gateway's own icon under the pad's own name, so the hub's map shows the way back in the hub's words rather than the gateway's. It has no recipe and no category and is a Variant, so the creative library hides it, and like the pad it copies nobody can break it.
